title: ABA SPEECH  - Videos
description:
Rose Griffin is a speech therapist and board certified behavior analyst. With less than 500 individuals holding both certifications, Rose is a leader in the field. Her mission is to help all students increase their communication skills. 

Learn more by taking a Complimentary ASHA and ACE approved course about foundational skills for autistic learners: https://abaspeech.org/shop/courses/foundational-communication-skills-for-autistic-learners/

Join me to learn more about helping your autistic child or student find their voice: https://abaspeech.org/
